about: Al Kharid, the Misthalin roadmap's Al Kharid piece. Tiles from 2004Scape's map m51_50 (its npc 925 borderguard1 and 926 borderguard2), checked against the 241 map floor and the Wiki's Toll gate map. They stand still, as 2004Scape has them (it only turns them now and then; left out, guessed).
